data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** Creating every plugin before any start hook prevents later factories from observing state installed by earlier plugins. The OTel factories now bind the provider, extract context, read `Span.current()`, and start the Invocation span during construction, so a preceding initializer/context plugin can leave OTel disabled or incorrectly parented. Create and start plugins in registration order, or move OTel’s context-sensitive initialization back to `onInvocationStart` with safe publication, and update the ordering test.
